subject: Recap: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@atlas-payments.com>, Priya Rao <priya@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and clear next steps. Below is a concise recap of what we discussed and the proposed plan for the POC/trial so we can align on expectations and ownership. Please reply with any edits.

Summary of agreed success criteria / KPIs
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 100 ms for typical user prompts (target).
- Throughput: sustain 50 requests/sec for peak traffic profiles without degradation.
- Cost: target cost/token <= $0.0005, hard ceiling $0.0007 for the trial.
- Quality: intent-classification/response-quality measured on an eval set: >= 92% accuracy and hallucination rate < 2% (details below).

Evaluation plan
- Dataset & traffic: Atlas will provide a representative set of 2,000 queries + a week of anonymized traffic replay (sample).
- Test types: baseline functional correctness, latency/throughput soak, and quality regression checks against the eval set.
- Sequences: evaluate at both short (~64 token) and long (~512 token) sequences for latency profiles.
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, errors/timeouts, tokens-per-request cost, quality pass-rate on labeled eval set.

Timeline & ownership
- Week 0 (kickoff, Jun 30): finalize dataset, access, and schedule kickoff.
- Week 1: ingest dataset, run baseline correctness + initial latency profile.
- Week 2: stress/throughput testing, cost analysis, and final report + recommendations.
Owners: Samir (Atlas) — product lead; Marissa (Redwood) — solution/implementation lead; Jordan (Redwood) — sales owner / PM for coordination.

Deliverables
- Redwood: PoC plan PDF, eval scripts, temporary dedicated queue + dashboard access, interim report at end of Week 1, final report at end of Week 2.
- Atlas: dataset + traffic samples, test account access, point of contact for replay orchestration.

Next steps
1) I will share the PoC plan & eval scripts (attached) and a calendar invite for kickoff: Wed, Jun 30, 10:00 AM PT.
2) Samir / Priya to confirm dataset ownership and who will provision the sample traffic.
3) Marissa to confirm infra requirements (GPU/queue) and any IP restrictions.

Thanks — happy to align further in the kickoff meeting.

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Samir Shah <samir@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments

Thanks Jordan — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:
- The 2,000 query eval set is a representative sample; we will also include a ~500-example edge-case set for hallucination checks.
- Cost target: $0.0005/token is acceptable as a target; if we hit ~$0.0006 we can accept temporarily as long as quality is stable.
- For throughput, 50 req/sec sustained is the target but please also show headroom to 100 req/sec for short bursts.

We confirm kickoff Wed Jun 30 at 10 AM PT. Priya will own dataset delivery and coordinate our security team for access. Marissa — can you confirm the credentials/setup you need for the replay?

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

Best,
Samir
Head of Product | Atlas Payments
samir@atlas-payments.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@atlas-payments.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@atlas-payments.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: POC success criteria & KPIs - Atlas Payments

Adding some technical details so we can size the PoC correctly:
- Latency numbers will depend on sequence length; we will report p50/p95/p99 for 64-token and 512-token distributions separately. The p95 <=100ms target is achievable for 64-token median prompts on our optimized kernels; for 512-token p95 we may see ~2-3x the 64-token numbers — we'll measure and include recommendations (quantization / token caching) if needed.
- Throughput: to validate 50 req/sec sustained we will run a 30-minute soak at target QPS and an additional 10-minute burst to 100 req/sec.
- Cost/token: we will instrument the trial and provide per-route token cost estimates based on observed batching/efficiency.
- Eval harness: included in the attached poc-eval-scripts.csv (basic script + scoring). We will also provide a shared dashboard link during the trial.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, poc-eval-scripts.csv

I'll prepare the infra checklist for the kickoff (service accounts, dataset upload location, IP allowlist). Jordan — would you like me to set up the dashboard access ahead of Wed?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Priya Rao <priya@atlas-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

See you all on Wed at 10 AM PT.
